**Review: peppermint product page copy**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Just peppermint leaves, nothing else" | Product fact (ingredients), fine as written |
| "Cool and clean after a big meal" | Flavour and occasion description, fine. It doesn't say the tea aids digestion or settles the stomach. Keep it that way. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted, exact wording, certificate on file (renewed 2026) |

**Other checks**
- No superlatives, guarantees, health claims, green claims, invented numbers, testimonials or fake urgency.
- No banned words or structures. The tone is warm, plain and unhurried, and the spelling is UK.
- No disclosure is needed, since this is our own product page and not a paid partnership or affiliate link.

**Before it goes out:** the policy requires Sam (marketing lead) to approve all public content, so get sign-off first. The copy itself needs no changes.
